compute.note: parameters evaluated from the stated architecture: FastLSTMNet, layers = 2, features = [16, 2] (the last layer has hilbert.local_size = 2 features), real float32 parameters. Each LSTM layer l has a kernel (in_l + n_prev f_l) x 4 f_l and a bias 4 f_l, with in_0 = 1 (the spin at the previous site), in_1 = 16, and n_prev = 2 previous neighbours per site: NetKet orders the 100 sites of the graph vmc.py builds (nk.graph.Grid([10, 10], pbc=True)) greedily and takes the median number of earlier neighbours, rounded up (median 2; evaluated here by re-implementing ordering.py, not by running NetKet). So (1 + 2*16)*64 + 64 = 2176 and (16 + 2*2)*8 + 8 = 168, total 2344. samples = 1024 per optimisation step (MCState n_samples = batch_size; ARDirectSampler (autoregressive, one pass per sample)); iterations = 100000 (--max_step 100000); optimizer Adam, lr 1e-3. The final energy is then estimated once with estim_size = 1024^2 = 1048576 samples (not an optimisation step). NetKet pinned twice by the program: programs/vmc_netket/requirements.txt "NetKet==3.13.0" and conda_env.yaml "netket=3.11.4"; every NetKet line cited here reads the same at both tags.
